title: Golden-fixture envelope
$comment: WP-F06 — the LOCKED fixture file envelope (14-fixtures-harness.md §2). Every tree/design/html/roundtrip/smoke fixture is a single JSON object with this shape so the TS (fixture-loader.ts) and PHP (class-fixture-loader.php) runners interpret it IDENTICALLY. `expect.errors[]` are SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE taxonomy codes (12-error-taxonomy.md §3/§6) — NEVER raw Elementor throw-message strings (the `errors` enum below enforces this; a bare throw string fails `fixtures:validate`). The embedded `tree[]` is validated SEPARATELY against the authoring schemas (element-node.schema.json) by `pnpm fixtures:validate`, not inline here, to keep this envelope self-contained.

id.description: Unique fixture id; MUST equal the filename minus the .json extension (14-fixtures-harness.md §2).

generation.description: Authoring generation of the embedded tree (page-tree.schema.json#/$defs/Generation).

title.description: Human-readable one-line description of what the fixture exercises.

expect.description: The AUTHORITATIVE expectation. `valid` is the PHP dry_run verdict (§3); when valid:false, `errors` is the expected taxonomy-code SET (order-independent, §3 step 2d).

valid.description: PHP dry_run verdict for this fixture's tree+settings (§3 — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH).

errors.description: When valid:false, the expected error CODES (NOT messages). SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE taxonomy codes only (12-error-taxonomy.md §6). A bare Elementor throw-string here FAILS validation by design ([R8], §2).

allOf.$comment: Cross-check: a valid fixture carries no expected errors; an invalid fixture carries at least one.

requires.description: Capability gates (14-fixtures-harness.md §2). A fixture whose `requires` are unmet on the target install is SKIPPED (reported skipped, not failed) by BOTH loaders.

experiments.description: Experiment slugs that MUST be active (12-error-taxonomy.md §3.4).

pro.description: Whether Elementor Pro must be active for this fixture to run.

tree.description: Array of ElementNode (11-authoring-contract.md §1, element-node.schema.json). Present for kind:tree/roundtrip/smoke. Validated against the authoring schemas by `fixtures:validate`.

prefilter.description: TS pre-filter contract for THIS fixture (14-fixtures-harness.md §4). Asserted by prefilter-subset.test.ts.

verdict.description: accept | reject | defer (§4). accept⇒expect.valid==true; reject⇒expect.valid==false (corpus meta-invariant).

input_tree.description: kind:roundtrip only — the tree to page.build (14-fixtures-harness.md §7). Array of ElementNode.

normalized_expected.description: kind:roundtrip only — the expected normalized tree after build→get_structure→normalize (§7).

tool.description: kind:smoke only — the FULL lean ★ tool name this payload exercises (13-tool-catalog.md §5.2), e.g. "elementor.page.dry_run".

arguments.description: kind:smoke only — the minimal valid input payload for the named tool (Inspector smoke, §8).

merge_regression.description: Optional settings-merge regression block ([S04/C3/R3]). When present, the dry-run/settings suite seeds `seed`, applies `patch`, and asserts `survives`/`updates` hold after update_settings (deep merge), proving the controller did not bare-save (REPLACE).

seed.description: ≥3 settings of different types including ≥1 nested map (e.g. background_color, background_background, nested padding).

patch.description: Patch updating exactly ONE top-level key and ONE nested sub-key, omitting the rest.

survives.description: Dotted paths (e.g. "padding.left") whose values MUST be unchanged after the patch.

updates.description: Dotted paths whose values MUST equal the patched values after the patch.

_comment.description: Free-form authoring note (ignored by both loaders).
